_meta.what: Raw RBI publication date → the month-end it is counted as.
_meta.why: A remap decides which MONTH a number belongs to; getting it wrong misdates the data rather than breaking it, so nothing downstream would notice. update_web_data.py --check fails if the computed remapping ever differs from this.
_meta.baseline: Captured 2026-08-11 from the already-committed consolidated CSV, which had passed every gate. Not a fresh judgment — the status quo, written down. Any date added or moved from here on stops the pipeline for a human.
